Subject: Holdback validation & stage hygiene — Q3 renewal sync

Team — quick heads up from Finance: we received a tighter holdback review for a subset of Q3 renewals. To avoid surprises in the July forecast close, we need a short hygiene pass on any deals currently marked as "Commit (holdback)" or with staged discounts that could trigger deferred revenue adjustments.

Ask (priority order):
1) Update the CRM stage to the most defensible status by EOD Wednesday (2027-06-09). If the account is not final, set to "Best Case" + add a one-line rationale in the notes.
2) For any deal with a holdback flag, populate the attached template with: committed ARR, withheld amount, expected signature window, and owner (Sales + CS).
3) Flag any accounts with procurement/legal dependencies (DocuSign/PO outstanding) — we should expect potential slippage.

I'll compile the rollup for Finance on Thursday AM and push to the forecast model. Naomi, attaching your template would be helpful (I can distribute).

Thanks — short and sharp: this is about clean inputs, not re-evaluating strategy.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Adding the template (attached) and a few clarifications from Finance to reduce back-and-forth:
- Definition: "Holdback" = portion of ARR we are not recognizing at commit because of outstanding commercial/legal items (PO, multi-factor approvals, payment term changes).
- Threshold for review: any deal > $50k ARR with a holdback flag or any deal where expected recognition is >30 days later than billed close.
- Please ensure the "owner" field in the template has both Sales and CS names (we'll use this to ping people for follow-up).

Example line for HelioData (fill-in by Monica/David):
HelioData Inc. | $210,000 ARR | Holdback $21,000 | Expected signature 2027-08-18 | Owner: David Kim / Monica Patel | Notes: Procurement reviewing SOW — PO expected 2-3 weeks after signature.

Upload the completed template to the Drive folder below and set file permissions to anyone with link (Finance will pull it into the model).

Attachment: Q3_holdbacks_template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28 KB)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bHelioHoldbacks
